name: user-profile
title: UserProfile
description: Avatar plus name and optional meta in one block. Account headers and people cards.
docs: ATOM UIKit ships global BEM classes. CSS files MUST be imported in a global stylesheet (e.g. app/globals.css) — do not convert them to CSS Modules. Foundations (tokens/foundation) are not installed via this shadcn channel; use the Atom MCP or full DS setup for design tokens. Tuning ranges and gotchas: see meta.agent when present.

gotchas.note: name is required. avatar spreads Avatar props; initials default from name words. org is optional subtitle.
Ensure Avatar gets a meaningful alt/aria via avatar props when using image type.

agent.usage:
import { UserProfile } from '@/components/atoms/UserProfile';

<UserProfile name="Ada Lovelace" org="Analytical Engines" avatar={{ type: 'initials', size: 's' }} />
